items.q: here's Bushell and all of them, Johnny Letman and Lips and everybody, and I'm up there looking

ctx.x: next -- uh-uh. So Delaunay had told me everything, you know, that's how come I like him so much. Said, "Don't be going out there and working cheap and everything, because you come over here, you get straight, go on home. That's where so many of them make a mistake. Go home, and then when you come back again, maybe you can get your money again. But if you stay here it's got to go down." I wound up helping some of them guys out over there.

Then I come back, things are very bad. I see Lips Page, he's playing for the political thing, you know, going up Seventh Avenue. I walk down Seventh Avenue, here's Bushell and all of them, Johnny Letman and Lips and everybody, and I'm up there looking, because I've been so high over there, you know. Over there I was an artiste, you know.
